description: Botlify lets people claim a slug and turn a documentation site or website into a public Grok Bot knowledge source. It crawls same-host sitemap and `llms.txt` content, then publishes an install page and public MCP for each claimed bot.
summary: Botlify exposes a public streamable-HTTP MCP at `https://botlify.sh/api/mcp/:slug`, a public JSON directory at `GET /api/directory`, and public per-bot agent metadata at `GET /agents/:slug.md`; no developer credentials are required for the documented surfaces.
